why.detail-routes: [id]/[symbol]/[coinId] pages are reached from their list, which builds the href by interpolation. A nav entry cannot supply an id.
why.auth-flow: /auth/callback and /auth/reset-password are arrived at from an email link, never a click inside the app.
why.onboarding: The post-signup flow. Entered by redirect after registration; deliberately chrome-free.
why.marketing: /about, /features, /privacy-policy and /terms belong to the Footer on the marketing site, not the app sidebar.
why.admin: Admin-only pages are deliberately absent from the user navigation.
